**ShipmentTracker** — a Blazor Web App with **Auto render mode** (Server-side for fast first load, then WebAssembly for snappy client-side interaction without server round-trips).

### Architecture decisions matching your requirements:

| Requirement | Solution |
|---|---|
| Fast first load | Server-side prerendering on initial visit |
| Snappy after load | WebAssembly takes over — no server round-trips |
| Worldwide users | WASM runs locally in-browser, eliminating latency |
| Interactive controls | `@rendermode InteractiveAuto` on every page |
| Authentication | ASP.NET Identity with Individual accounts, Dispatcher/Customer roles |

### Key files:
- **`ShipmentTracker.Client/Pages/Dispatcher.razor`** — filterable shipment table with inline edit modal (status, destination, ETA, recipient)
- **`ShipmentTracker.Client/Pages/TrackShipment.razor`** — public tracking search with progress bar and delivery status
- **`ShipmentTracker/Program.cs`** — API endpoints, role seeding, 25 sample shipments
- **`ShipmentTracker/Data/Shipment.cs`** — EF Core entity with SQLite

### To run:
```bash
cd ShipmentTracker && dotnet run --project ShipmentTracker
```
